## Affected Components

- Dashboard

## Out of Scope

- Localization string review beyond the changed label

None.

# Rename "Data Science Projects" navigation label to "Projects"

## Description

This epic delivers a user-visible label change in the Dashboard UI: the
"Data Science Projects" navigation entry and the corresponding page headings
are renamed to "Projects". Usability testing showed that users arriving from
OpenShift are confused by the longer label, since the same underlying
resources are called projects there. Product management has approved the
shortened label. The change is limited to UI strings and the documentation
touch-ups that fall out of it; no behavior, routing, API, or Kubernetes
resource changes are involved.

## Scope

- Replace the "Data Science Projects" label with "Projects" in the Dashboard
  navigation menu.
- Update Dashboard page headings that display the "Data Science Projects"
  label to show "Projects".
- Update any other user-visible Dashboard strings that render the old label
  as the name of the projects section, keeping the change to display text
  only (no routes, CRD names, or API fields change).
- Update documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old label
  in the affected topics so docs match the new UI text (incidental touch-ups
  falling out of the same change — no new documentation content is authored).

Out of scope (per strategy):

- Renaming the underlying Kubernetes resources or CRDs.
- Localization string review beyond the changed label.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given the Dashboard is loaded, when the user views the navigation menu,
  then the entry formerly labeled "Data Science Projects" is labeled
  "Projects".
- Given the user navigates to the projects section, when the page renders,
  then all page headings that previously read "Data Science Projects" read
  "Projects".
- Given a search of the Dashboard codebase for user-facing occurrences of
  the old label, when the rename is complete, then no user-visible
  occurrence of "Data Science Projects" remains (test IDs, routes, and
  technical identifiers are unaffected).
- Given the affected documentation topics, when they are reviewed, then
  captions and references that mention the old label are updated to
  "Projects".

## HLR Traceability

- HLR-1 (P2): Dashboard navigation and page headings show "Projects" instead
  of "Data Science Projects" — covered by the UI string replacement in Scope.
- HLR-2 (P2): Documentation screenshots' captions and references to the old
  label are updated in the affected topics — covered by the documentation
  touch-ups in Scope.
